def is_nested(string):
    open_brackets = []
    for i, bracket in enumerate(string):
        if bracket == '[':
            open_brackets.append(i)
        elif bracket == ']':
            if not open_brackets:
                return False  # Unmatched closing bracket
            last_open_index = open_brackets.pop()
            
            # Check if there's a possibility of nesting
            if len(open_brackets) > 0 or (i - last_open_index > 1):
                return True
    
    return False

# Test cases
print(is_nested('[[]]'))       # ➞ True
print(is_nested('[]]]]]]][[[[[]'))   # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[][]'))      # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[]'))        # ➞ False
print(is_nested('[[][]]'))    # ➞ True
print(is_nested('[[]][['))    # ➞ True

CONFIDENCE: 95
